episodes.title: The Ex Returns

scenes.caption: She's back. And she's not asking permission.
scenes.narration: The mansion doors swing open, and she walks in like she owns everything—including my husband's past.

scenes.caption: He turns pale. Who is she to him?
scenes.narration: Elena, my ice-cold billionaire husband, freezes at the sight of her. In two years, I've never seen him afraid.

scenes.caption: I'm the wife. So why do I feel like the intruder?
scenes.narration: I stand in my simple silk gown, invisible, as the woman glides toward him. 'Adrian, darling, did you miss me?'

scenes.caption: The woman who broke him first.
scenes.narration: 'Vivian,' Adrian whispers, his voice cracking. The name he swore he'd buried. His first love. The one who left him at the altar.

scenes.caption: She knows about the contract.
scenes.narration: Vivian's eyes slice toward me. 'So this is the little charity case you married for the company?' She laughs. 'How much did he pay you, sweetheart?'

scenes.caption: Someone betrayed me.
scenes.narration: My blood runs cold. Only three people knew the truth of our marriage. How does she know?

scenes.caption: She came armed with paper.
scenes.narration: Adrian steps between us, jaw tight. 'Vivian, you have no right to be here.' But she smiles, pulling a folded document from her purse.

scenes.caption: Still married... to her?!
scenes.narration: She unfolds it slowly. 'Actually, darling—I have every right. Because legally, I'm still your wife.' The room spins as Adrian's face shatters.

episodes.title: A Kiss for the Cameras

scenes.caption: The world is watching us tonight.
scenes.narration: The paparazzi swarm the charity gala, and the contract demands one thing: proof of love.

scenes.caption: Smile. Convince them we're in love.
scenes.narration: Damian pulls her close, his whisper as sharp as ice. Smile, wife. Convince them.

scenes.caption: Just a kiss for the cameras.
scenes.narration: His lips meet hers for the cameras — but her heart betrays the lie, racing against her will.

scenes.caption: His ex-lover won't let go.
scenes.narration: Across the room, Vivienne watches, her painted smile twisting into a blade of jealousy.

scenes.caption: That wasn't part of the deal.
scenes.narration: When they part, Elena sees it in his eyes — something real flickering beneath the ice.

scenes.caption: I can't forget why I'm here.
scenes.narration: But revenge is a promise she made in blood, and love was never on her list.

scenes.caption: I know what you really are.
scenes.narration: Vivienne approaches with a poisoned toast and a secret that could shatter everything.

scenes.caption: He's planning to destroy you.
scenes.narration: Then Vivienne leans in and whispers the truth — Damian signed a second contract, one that ends with Elena gone.

episodes.title: The Hidden Will

scenes.caption: A secret hidden for years...
scenes.narration: The old mansion smells of dust and secrets. Elena clutches a yellowed envelope she found hidden behind the library shelf.

scenes.caption: The hidden will changes everything.
scenes.narration: Inside is a will — signed by his late father, dated one day before his mysterious death. Her hands tremble.

scenes.caption: An heir the family buried.
scenes.narration: The words burn into her: everything belongs not to Adrian — but to a child no one has ever spoken of.

scenes.caption: He wasn't supposed to see this.
scenes.narration: Footsteps echo. Adrian enters, his cold gray eyes locking onto the paper in her grasp.

scenes.caption: 'You don't know what you've done.'
scenes.narration: 'Where did you find that?' His voice is ice, but his hands shake with something like fear.

scenes.caption: She came for money. She stays for war.
scenes.narration: Elena pulls away, heart pounding. This is the weapon she needs — the revenge she signed up for.

scenes.caption: The one person nobody expected.
scenes.narration: Then a voice from the doorway freezes them both. 'That will is fake — and I can prove it.'

scenes.caption: Her secret is about to shatter everything...
scenes.narration: Elena's blood runs cold — the woman is Adrian's presumed-dead mother. And she knows Elena's real name.

episodes.title: Betrayed at Midnight

scenes.caption: Midnight. The truth finally in her hands.
scenes.narration: The clock strikes twelve, and Ella clutches the hidden will against her chest, certain tonight everything changes.

scenes.caption: He knew she was coming.
scenes.narration: Adrian appears from the shadows, his steel-grey eyes colder than she has ever seen them.

scenes.caption: "Give it to me, Ella."
scenes.narration: "That will was never yours to find," he whispers, extending his hand for it.

scenes.caption: The ex was pulling every string.
scenes.narration: Then Vivian glides in, a cruel smile curving her lips, revealing she orchestrated it all.

scenes.caption: Every kiss was a lie.
scenes.narration: "He married you to bait me," Vivian laughs, and Ella's world shatters in an instant.

scenes.caption: "You used my heart as a weapon."
scenes.narration: Adrian reaches for Ella, but she slaps his hand away, the will trembling in her grasp.

scenes.caption: Someone wants him dead — tonight.
scenes.narration: Suddenly gunshots crack through the chandelier, glass rains down, and a masked intruder aims straight at Adrian.

scenes.caption: To be continued...
scenes.narration: As the trigger clicks, Ella lunges between them — and the screen cuts to black on her scream.

episodes.title: Her Real Identity

scenes.caption: The mask comes off tonight.
scenes.narration: Lena stands in the shattered study, betrayal still burning in her chest. But tonight, she is no longer the frightened bride he purchased.

scenes.caption: "Who are you, really?"
scenes.narration: Adrian storms in, disbelief written across his face. The wife he underestimated holds a folder that could destroy his entire empire.

scenes.caption: "I didn't marry you for money."
scenes.narration: She drops the file on the desk. Inside lies proof that his family stole everything from hers years ago.

scenes.caption: The daughter he destroyed came back.
scenes.narration: Adrian's hands tremble as he reads. The orphan girl his father ruined has returned as his own wife.

scenes.caption: "Revenge wore a wedding dress."
scenes.narration: "Every rule you gave me, I obeyed. While I mapped every secret you tried to bury." Her voice never wavers.

scenes.caption: He never expected to fall.
scenes.narration: He reaches for her, torn between fury and a love he never meant to feel. "Then why does my heart still choose you?"

scenes.caption: "Neither of you leaves alive."
scenes.narration: Suddenly the study doors slam open. His ex-fiancée Vivian stands there, a gun glinting in her manicured hand.

scenes.caption: To be continued...
scenes.narration: Vivian's eyes gleam with madness. "You both think this was your game? The real will names me." The trigger clicks.

episodes.title: The Contract Burns

scenes.caption: The contract that bound them is about to burn.
scenes.narration: Elena stands before the fireplace, the marriage contract trembling in her hands. Tonight, she finally understands the price of every lie Adrian told her.

scenes.caption: He never expected her to fight back.
scenes.narration: Adrian bursts through the doors, his cold gray eyes wide with panic. For the first time, the untouchable billionaire looks truly afraid.

scenes.caption: Every secret she hid was a weapon.
scenes.narration: "You bought my name, my silence, my body," Elena whispers. "But you never bought my loyalty."

scenes.caption: The chains are finally breaking.
scenes.narration: She lets the pages slip into the flames. The contract that trapped her curls into ash and smoke.

scenes.caption: The truth she never knew.
scenes.narration: "Do you know what you've just done?" Adrian grabs her wrist. "That contract was the only thing keeping you alive."

scenes.caption: Who was really pulling the strings?
scenes.narration: Elena's heart stops. The revenge she planned suddenly feels like a trap someone else set for her.

scenes.caption: A ghost from the past returns.
scenes.narration: A phone buzzes on the marble table. The screen glows with a message from the one person they both believed was dead.

scenes.caption: The debt is far from over.
scenes.narration: As the flames die, headlights cut through the windows. Someone has come to collect what the burning contract left unpaid.

episodes.title: Forever, Unsigned

scenes.caption: The contract is gone. The war begins.
scenes.narration: The ashes of their contract still smolder on the marble floor. Elena thought burning it would set her free—but freedom always costs blood.

scenes.caption: "Who are you really, Elena?"
scenes.narration: Adrian storms in, his jaw tight, betrayal written across his face. He learned her true name only yesterday—now he demands the truth.

scenes.caption: Revenge wore a wedding dress.
scenes.narration: "I married you to destroy your family," she whispers, tears glistening. "Your father killed mine. This was never about the money."

scenes.caption: "Your father's death wasn't what you think."
scenes.narration: Adrian reels—but from his coat he pulls a folded document. The hidden will. Proof that everything she believed was a lie built by others.

scenes.caption: The ex returns—armed.
scenes.narration: Then the door bursts open. Vivienne, his ex, glides in with a cruel smile and a gun trembling in her manicured hand.

scenes.caption: "Shoot me instead."
scenes.narration: "You both ruined me," Vivienne hisses. "So neither of you leaves this room alive." Adrian steps in front of Elena.

scenes.caption: He took the bullet for her.
scenes.narration: A gunshot cracks like thunder. Elena screams as Adrian collapses into her arms, crimson blooming across his white shirt.

scenes.caption: "He's not the one you should fear."
scenes.narration: As Adrian's eyes flutter shut, he presses a ring into her palm and whispers a name she never expected. Then—another figure steps from the shadows.

episodes.title: The Billionaire's New Housemaid

scenes.caption: They hired a maid. They hired their reckoning.
scenes.narration: Elena Vasquez walks through gilded gates she once called home, wearing a maid's uniform. They fired her father, buried her family name—but they never learned her face.

scenes.caption: To him, she was invisible.
scenes.narration: Inside, billionaire Marcus Thornbury barely glances at her. To him, she is furniture. He has no idea he is standing on land she legally owns.

scenes.caption: Every insult, she remembers.
scenes.narration: His cruel daughter Victoria hurls a wine glass at Elena's feet. 'Clean it, servant.' Elena kneels, smiling secretly—patience is a weapon.

scenes.caption: The deed. Everything is hers.
scenes.narration: That night, Elena unlocks a hidden briefcase in her tiny quarters. Inside: the property deed to the entire Thornbury empire, signed decades ago to her late father.

scenes.caption: He destroyed her father. She never forgot.
scenes.narration: A framed photo slips from the deed—her father shaking hands with a younger Marcus. The betrayal that stole her family whispers back to life.

scenes.caption: She's been discovered.
scenes.narration: But someone is watching. Marcus's loyal butler, Gregory, has seen the deed. He knows exactly who she is.

scenes.caption: He knows. Or does he?
scenes.narration: At breakfast, Marcus taps his newspaper. 'I hear the true owner of my estate is closer than I think.' Elena's coffee pot freezes mid-pour.

scenes.caption: One envelope could end everything.
scenes.narration: Gregory steps forward, envelope in hand. 'Sir, there's something you must see about this woman.' Elena's heart stops. Her secret hangs by a single breath.

episodes.title: Scrubbing Floors for My Enemies

scenes.caption: Day one. Scrubbing my enemies' floors.
scenes.narration: Dawn breaks over the Ashford mansion as Elena kneels on the marble floor, scrubbing bucket at her side. They think she is nothing. They have no idea she owns the very ground beneath them.

scenes.caption: Pick that up, girl.
scenes.narration: Victoria Ashford descends the grand staircase, dripping in diamonds, her cruel smile cutting the air. She tosses her fur coat at Elena's feet without a glance.

scenes.caption: They don't know what I'm hiding.
scenes.narration: Elena retrieves the coat with trembling hands, biting back her fury. Inside her apron pocket, folded and secret, lies the deed to this entire empire.

scenes.caption: Clean it. Now.
scenes.narration: In the dining hall, the arrogant heir Julian Ashford flicks a wine glass to the floor, shattering it. 'Clean it,' he sneers, stepping over the shards.

scenes.caption: You took everything from my family.
scenes.narration: On her knees among broken glass, Elena's memory flashes to her father, ruined and destroyed by these very people. Her jaw tightens with silent vengeance.

scenes.caption: All of this is legally mine.
scenes.narration: Later, alone in the study, Elena slips the deed from her apron and studies the Ashford signatures. Every room, every jewel, every breath they take belongs to her.

scenes.caption: What is that in your hands?
scenes.narration: Suddenly the study door swings open. Victoria stands frozen in the doorway, her eyes locked on the document in Elena's hands.

scenes.caption: Give me that paper... or else.
scenes.narration: Victoria's voice drops to ice. 'Give me that paper — or I'll destroy you the way I destroyed everyone else.' Elena's grip tightens. The war has only just begun.

episodes.title: The Photograph They Should Have Burned

scenes.caption: Some secrets should have been burned.
scenes.narration: They think I am nothing. A servant polishing silver for the family that destroyed mine. But tonight, dusting the forgotten study, my fingers freeze on a drawer they should have locked.

scenes.caption: My mother... and their patriarch.
scenes.narration: An old photograph, edges yellowed by twenty years. My mother, young and smiling, standing beside a man in an expensive suit. The man who signed away everything she owned.

scenes.caption: He built his empire on her ruin.
scenes.narration: Footsteps. Richard Whitmore fills the doorway, silver-haired and cold, the man who buried my family in lies. He does not yet know the maid holds his deepest sin.

scenes.caption: Play the servant. For now.
scenes.narration: "What are you doing in here?" he snaps. I lower my eyes like the obedient servant they believe I am. But inside, a fire twenty years old roars back to life.

scenes.caption: He fears the truth more than death.
scenes.narration: He tears the room apart searching for the photo, never guessing it now sits against my heart. "If anyone finds that picture," he mutters, "I am finished."

scenes.caption: She left me a message.
scenes.narration: That night, in my tiny servant's room, I turn the photograph over. On the back, in my mother's handwriting, three words that change everything.

scenes.caption: My enemy... is my father.
scenes.narration: "He is your father." The words blur through my tears. The tyrant I swore to destroy — is the man whose blood runs in my veins.

scenes.caption: She knew all along.
scenes.narration: Suddenly my door creaks open. Margaret Whitmore stands there, smiling like a viper. "So," she whispers, "the little maid finally knows the truth."

episodes.title: A Toast to the Woman They Wronged

scenes.caption: They toasted their empire. They never knew it was mine.
scenes.narration: The Ashfords raise their glasses to celebrate the empire they believe is theirs. They toast their triumph, never dreaming the woman refilling their crystal owns every brick beneath their feet.

scenes.caption: 'To the family that built it all.'
scenes.narration: "To the family that built it all," Camilla declares, her voice dripping with false grace. Elena lowers her eyes, a private smile hidden behind years of silence.

scenes.caption: He snapped his fingers. He'd regret it soon.
scenes.narration: Julian snaps his fingers, ordering more wine, treating her like furniture. He has no idea the deed she carries could erase his name by morning.

scenes.caption: The ring they thought was lost forever.
scenes.narration: As Elena pours, her sleeve slips, revealing a signet ring the Ashfords once thought lost forever. Camilla's glass freezes at her lips.

scenes.caption: 'Where did you get that ring?'
scenes.narration: "Where did you get that ring?" Camilla hisses, the room falling silent. Elena straightens her spine, no longer the servant they bought.

scenes.caption: 'A toast to the woman you wronged.'
scenes.narration: Elena sets down the bottle and lifts an empty glass of her own. "Allow me," she says, "to make a toast to the woman you wronged."

scenes.caption: 'All of it is mine.'
scenes.narration: From her apron she draws a folded document stamped in gold. "This mansion, this empire, this name — all of it is mine." Victor's glass shatters on the marble.

scenes.caption: The man they buried just walked in.
scenes.narration: But as the family reels, the great doors swing open — and a man they buried years ago walks in, calling Elena's name. She turns, and the color drains from her face.

episodes.title: Midnight in the Locked Study

scenes.caption: Midnight. The study they forbade her to enter.
scenes.narration: The mansion sleeps, but Elena does not. Tonight, the locked study finally surrenders its secrets to the woman they call a servant.

scenes.caption: One turn of the key changes everything.
scenes.narration: The key turns. The door groans open. Every answer she has bled for waits inside this room.

scenes.caption: The proof was here all along.
scenes.narration: On the desk, a leather folder bearing the Ashford crest — the same family that stole her father's empire.

scenes.caption: They forged his signature. They took it all.
scenes.narration: Contracts. Forged signatures. The murder of her family's fortune written in ink. Her hands tremble with fury.

scenes.caption: The maid holds the deed to their empire.
scenes.narration: She slips the deed to the entire estate from her hidden pocket. She truly owns them all. They just don't know yet.

scenes.caption: Footsteps. She is not alone.
scenes.narration: Suddenly — footsteps in the corridor. The lamp behind her flickers. Someone knows she is here.

scenes.caption: "Cleaning at midnight, my dear?"
scenes.narration: The door swings wide. Victor Ashford, master of the house, stands in his silk robe — a cruel smile curling his lips.

scenes.caption: He sees the deed. The mask shatters.
scenes.narration: His eyes drop to the deed in her hand. His smile dies. "Where," he whispers, "did you get that?" The war has begun.

episodes.title: The Signature That Buys a Dynasty

scenes.caption: One signature. One dynasty. One reckoning.
scenes.narration: Dawn breaks over the Hartwell estate, but Elena has not slept. In her trembling hands rests the document that will end them all.

scenes.caption: The old lion thinks he's already won.
scenes.narration: Victor Hartwell summons the family to sign away the last shares of the empire, certain of his triumph.

scenes.caption: He never noticed the servant who owns him.
scenes.narration: Marcus watches the maid enter, unaware the woman he mocked now holds his family's fate.

scenes.caption: This estate was never yours to sell.
scenes.narration: Elena steps forward and lays the deed on the table, its faded signature glowing under the chandeliers.

scenes.caption: The signature he prayed no one would find.
scenes.narration: Victor's face drains of color as he recognizes his own father's handwriting, the truth he buried decades ago.

scenes.caption: The maid was always the master.
scenes.narration: 'Every floor I scrubbed,' Elena whispers, 'I was already standing in my own house.' The family recoils.

scenes.caption: He has a signature of his own.
scenes.narration: But as Victor reaches into his jacket, a second document appears — one Elena has never seen. His smile returns, colder than before.

episodes.title: She Called Me Family—Then Sold Me Out

scenes.caption: She called me family.
scenes.narration: For weeks the Ashford matriarch treated me like a daughter. But daughters are not sold to the highest bidder.

scenes.caption: A 'gift' with a hidden knife.
scenes.narration: That morning, Vivian pressed papers into my hands, calling it a gift. I smiled—until I read the fine print.

scenes.caption: Sold. Like property.
scenes.narration: She had signed me away—leased my labor, my silence, my life—to a rival tycoon, like furniture.

scenes.caption: 'You were only an asset.'
scenes.narration: 'You were never one of us,' Vivian hissed. 'You were an asset. And assets get traded.'

scenes.caption: They forgot who owns it all.
scenes.narration: They forgot one thing. Every deed in this house—every stone, every acre—already belongs to me.

scenes.caption: The real papers surface.
scenes.narration: That night I returned to the locked study, unlocked the safe, and laid the true documents on the table.

scenes.caption: Let the trap close.
scenes.narration: When Vivian summoned her lawyers to finalize my 'sale,' I let them enter—then locked the doors behind them.

scenes.caption: The dead walk back in.
scenes.narration: I slid the deed across the table. 'You didn't sell me,' I whispered. 'You just signed everything to the woman you wronged.' Then the doors flew open—and someone stepped in who was supposed to be dead.

episodes.title: The Boardroom Knows My Real Name

scenes.caption: They think I'm just the maid.
scenes.narration: They summoned me to the boardroom to serve coffee, not knowing today the servant becomes the sovereign.

scenes.caption: He built this empire on my family's grave.
scenes.narration: Gerald Ashford, the patriarch who once called me hired help, smirks as he opens the merger papers.

scenes.caption: 'The controlling shareholder is present.'
scenes.narration: Then the lawyer clears his throat and reads a name that turns every face to stone.

scenes.caption: Elena Vasquez. The rightful owner.
scenes.narration: I set down the tray, remove my apron, and speak the name they buried long ago—my name.

scenes.caption: He finally remembers the girl he ruined.
scenes.narration: Gerald's coffee cup shatters on the marble floor as recognition drains the color from his face.

scenes.caption: You've been working for me all along.
scenes.narration: I slide the deed across the polished table—every asset, every share, signed to me.

scenes.caption: My sister. Alive. And on his side.
scenes.narration: But then the boardroom doors burst open, and a woman I thought long dead walks in smiling.

scenes.caption: Two heirs. One throne. War begins.
scenes.narration: She holds up a second deed—identical to mine—and asks which of us the empire truly obeys.

episodes.title: Everything You Own Was Always Mine

scenes.caption: You don't fire the woman who owns your house.
scenes.narration: They gathered in the marble foyer expecting to fire the maid. Instead, they found the woman who owns the walls they're standing on.

scenes.caption: He thinks I'm bluffing.
scenes.narration: Victor laughs, sure this is some pathetic bluff. He has no idea the deed left his family's hands years ago.

scenes.caption: Read it. Then read it again.
scenes.narration: I slide the folder across the table. Every property, every account, every lie—signed over to me.

scenes.caption: The maid was never the maid.
scenes.narration: Vivienne's face drains white. The woman she called family, then sold out, holds their entire dynasty in her palm.

scenes.caption: Everything you own was always mine.
scenes.narration: Julian lunges, snarling that I'm nothing but hired help. I remind him the mortgage on his very bed is mine.

scenes.caption: I don't need your key anymore.
scenes.narration: I take the master key from my pocket—the same one they gave the maid—and drop it at their feet.

scenes.caption: He whispered a name that stopped my heart.
scenes.narration: But as security arrives to escort them out, Victor smiles—and whispers that he still has one card left. The daughter I thought was dead.

episodes.title: The Maid Takes Her Throne

scenes.caption: They called for the maid. A queen answered.
scenes.narration: They summoned me to the grand hall one last time, expecting a servant to grovel. Instead, I walked in wearing the empire I now own.

scenes.caption: Everything she protected belonged to me.
scenes.narration: Vivian, the matriarch who once made me scrub her floors, clutched her pearls in disbelief. The throne she guarded was never truly hers.

scenes.caption: The deed to everything you love.
scenes.narration: Gerald slammed his fist on the antique table, demanding I explain myself. I simply slid the deed across the polished wood.

scenes.caption: You taught me betrayal. I mastered it.
scenes.narration: Marcus, the son who once smiled while betraying me, begged me to remember what we were. I remembered everything—that was the problem.

scenes.caption: The photo they should have destroyed.
scenes.narration: I placed the old photograph on the mantel—the one they should have burned. Proof I was the rightful heir all along.

scenes.caption: The maid takes her throne.
scenes.narration: One by one, the staff who once ignored me now bowed. The empire's true owner had finally claimed her throne.

scenes.caption: 'The real heir is still alive.'
scenes.narration: But as I savored my victory, my phone buzzed with a message that froze my blood: 'The real heir is still alive.' Someone else wants this empire too.

episodes.title: The Bride Who Woke With No Name

scenes.caption: Who am I?
scenes.narration: She wakes in a bed of silk and shadow, her mind a blank and endless void. No name, no past—only the pounding of a heart that remembers what she cannot.

scenes.caption: You're my Luna. My wife.
scenes.narration: A towering man enters, his eyes burning like molten gold. He calls her his mate—his Luna—but she feels only dread.

scenes.caption: Don't touch me—I don't know you!
scenes.narration: His touch sends fire and terror through her veins. Some buried part of her screams that this man is danger itself.

scenes.caption: This face... isn't mine.
scenes.narration: She flees into the halls and finds a shattered mirror. In the glass, a stranger stares back—and a faded tattoo marks her as something she cannot name.

scenes.caption: Kill the Alpha. Avenge them all.
scenes.narration: A hidden journal falls from her hand, its pages screaming a vow written in her own blood: destroy the Alpha who slaughtered her pack.

scenes.caption: My enemy... is my mate?
scenes.narration: The Alpha she swore to kill is the mate whose bed she woke in. Two truths collide, tearing her soul in half.

scenes.caption: You loved me once, Luna.
scenes.narration: He steps close, whispering that she once loved him with all her heart. But her fingers curl around the cold hilt of a hidden blade.

scenes.caption: I remember everything now.
scenes.narration: As the moon rises full and blood-red, her memories crash back in a single searing flash. And in that moment, she remembers exactly how he must die.

episodes.title: A Bite That Marked Me as His

scenes.caption: Whose bride am I?
scenes.narration: She wakes beneath silver banners, a stranger in her own skin. The mark on her neck burns like a brand she never chose.

scenes.caption: You are mine, Luna.
scenes.narration: He enters like a storm made flesh—broad, scarred, eyes of molten gold. 'You are mine,' he says, and her heart betrays her by racing.

scenes.caption: I swore to destroy him...
scenes.narration: Flashes tear through her mind—blood, fire, a vow whispered in the dark. She once swore to kill this very man.

scenes.caption: This bond is a death sentence.
scenes.narration: 'This bite binds our souls,' Kael murmurs, tracing the mark. 'Break it, and you die with me.' She recoils from the warmth she craves.

scenes.caption: My old self left me a weapon.
scenes.narration: Alone, she finds a hidden dagger sewn into her sleeve—her past self's final gift. Her hand trembles as memory and murder collide.

scenes.caption: They remember what I forgot.
scenes.narration: At the feast the pack bows to their lost Luna. But cruel whispers rise—'The bride who tried to slit the Alpha's throat.'

scenes.caption: Why couldn't he let me go?
scenes.narration: Kael pulls her close before the pack, lips at her ear. 'Remember it all, and you'll understand why I couldn't let you go.' The mark flares blinding white.

scenes.caption: Elara... finish what you started!
scenes.narration: Then a war horn shatters the night—enemy wolves storm the gates, and their leader shouts her true name. 'Elara! Kill him now, as you promised!'

episodes.title: The Alpha Who Swore to Kill My Bloodline

scenes.caption: I don't even know my own name.
scenes.narration: I wake with his mark burning on my throat, but my memories are ash. The man watching me is beautiful—and something inside me screams he is death.

scenes.caption: We are sworn enemies.
scenes.narration: 'You swore to kill my bloodline,' he says, voice like breaking ice. 'And I swore to end yours.' Yet his hand trembles when he reaches for me.

scenes.caption: The prophecy demands my death.
scenes.narration: A withered elder steps from the shadows. 'She is the last of the wolf-slayer line, Alpha Kael. The prophecy demands her death.' My blood runs cold.

scenes.caption: Flashes of a life I can't remember.
scenes.narration: Fragments flash—flames, a dagger, my own voice vowing vengeance against his father. Was I truly the monster they claim?

scenes.caption: The bond neither of us wanted.
scenes.narration: Kael's claws graze my cheek. 'Give me one reason to spare you, Luna.' My heart pounds—the mate bond he cannot deny.

scenes.caption: My old pack has found me.
scenes.narration: Then the doors explode inward. Warriors with silver blades storm the hall—my old pack, come to reclaim their weapon.

scenes.caption: My brother. My betrayer.
scenes.narration: Their leader lowers his hood—and my breath stops. His face is my face. 'Sister,' he snarls, 'finish what you started, or die a traitor.'

scenes.caption: Choose: your mate or your blood.
scenes.narration: He hurls a dagger to my feet. Kill Kael and remember who I am—or protect the enemy who marked my soul. My fingers close around the blade.

episodes.title: Whispers of a Life I Can't Remember

scenes.caption: Why does this place feel like home?
scenes.narration: I wake in a bed that isn't mine, in a fortress that hates my blood. Yet every stone whispers a name I cannot remember.

scenes.caption: My enemy watches me like he owns my soul.
scenes.narration: Kael, the Alpha who vowed to end my bloodline, stands guard at my door—his eyes burning with something crueler than hate.

scenes.caption: He says I begged for this bond.
scenes.narration: 'You bit me,' I whisper. He turns away as if the memory scalds him. 'You begged me to,' he answers.

scenes.caption: A photo of us... in love?
scenes.narration: A locket falls from his cloak. Inside—my face, smiling beside his. We were something once. We were everything.

scenes.caption: The memories are coming back... and they hurt.
scenes.narration: Flashes tear through my mind—laughter, a wedding vow, his lips on mine. Then blood. So much blood.

scenes.caption: He brought me back from death.
scenes.narration: 'What happened to us, Kael?' He grips my wrist, trembling. 'You died,' he breathes. 'And I did the unspeakable to bring you back.'

scenes.caption: My people are here to kill him.
scenes.narration: The war horns scream outside. My own pack storms the gates—the family who told me Kael slaughtered my bloodline. And they've come to burn him.

scenes.caption: He hands me the knife to end him.
scenes.narration: Kael presses a blade into my hand—the blade meant for his heart. 'They'll ask you to finish me,' he says. 'And I won't stop you.'

episodes.title: The Rival Luna Returns From the Dead

scenes.caption: She was supposed to be dead...
scenes.narration: The moonlit courtyard falls silent as a figure steps from the mist. Elara's heart stops—the dead do not walk, yet this woman breathes.

scenes.caption: The Alpha remembers her name.
scenes.narration: Kael's face drains of color. The name he buried for years rises from his lips like a curse: Seraphine.

scenes.caption: The rival Luna has returned.
scenes.narration: Seraphine glides forward, fiery red hair blazing, a cruel smile curling. 'You replaced me,' she purrs, 'with a creature who forgot her own soul.'

scenes.caption: A memory she can't escape.
scenes.narration: Fragments flash through Elara's mind—Seraphine's laughter, a dagger, blood on snow. Her lost memories claw to surface.

scenes.caption: What truth is he hiding?
scenes.narration: 'You never told her the truth, did you Kael?' Seraphine hisses. 'That she killed me once—and would do it again.'

scenes.caption: She fears her own past.
scenes.narration: Kael reaches for Elara, but she recoils, betrayal burning brighter than the moon. 'What did I do?' she whispers.

scenes.caption: Sister?!
scenes.narration: Seraphine lifts a trembling hand toward Elara. 'Come home, sister,' she breathes. The word shatters everything.

scenes.caption: The Luna awakens... at last.
scenes.narration: Elara's eyes flash gold—wolf and woman waking as one. The mark on her neck ignites, and the ground trembles beneath a truth no one is ready for.

episodes.title: His Betrayal Under the Blood Moon

scenes.caption: The blood moon reveals everything.
scenes.narration: The blood moon rises crimson over the fortress, and my heart pounds with a truth I dread to face. Kael, my mate, stands before an ancient altar—the one my nightmares warned me of.

scenes.caption: He hid the truth from me.
scenes.narration: He turns to me, silver eyes gleaming with something colder than love. 'Elara,' he says, 'there is something I never told you.'

scenes.caption: The dead Luna returns to claim him.
scenes.narration: From the shadows steps Seraphine—the rival Luna I believed dead—her lips curled in triumph. 'Did he tell you he made a pact with me?'

scenes.caption: I remember what he did to my family.
scenes.narration: My memories crash back in shattering waves—Kael's blade, my fallen family, his vow to end my bloodline. He was never my savior. He was my executioner.

scenes.caption: His mark was a weapon, not love.
scenes.narration: 'You marked me only to destroy the last of my line,' I whisper, betrayal burning through my veins. Kael reaches for me, but I recoil.

scenes.caption: He loved the woman he vowed to slay.
scenes.narration: 'I swore to kill you,' Kael confesses, voice breaking, 'until I fell in love with the enemy fate gave me.' But Seraphine only laughs.

scenes.caption: One of them must die tonight.
scenes.narration: Seraphine raises a glowing dagger etched with ancient runes. 'The pact demands her blood tonight, Kael—or yours.' The moon turns darker still.

scenes.caption: He offered his life for mine.
scenes.narration: Kael steps between us and bares his throat. 'Then take mine.' The dagger falls—and my scream shatters the blood moon night.

episodes.title: The Truth Hidden in My Own Scar

scenes.caption: This scar has always been mine... hasn't it?
scenes.narration: Kaela traces the jagged scar along her ribs, the wound she thought was a battle memory. But tonight it burns like it remembers something she cannot.

scenes.caption: The mark is glowing... it's a rune!
scenes.narration: The scar pulses silver, forming an ancient rune. A memory floods back—a child, a knife, a mother's scream.

scenes.caption: He knows what this mark means.
scenes.narration: Then he enters—Draven, the Alpha who marked her, the enemy she vowed to destroy. His eyes lock on the glowing scar and his face turns to ash.

scenes.caption: You did this to yourself, Kaela.
scenes.narration: 'You gave yourself that wound,' Draven whispers. 'To hide the truth from your own people—and from me.'

scenes.caption: I'm the heir of the prophecy...
scenes.narration: The rune reveals the impossible—Kaela is not the last of her bloodline. She is the lost heir the prophecy swore would destroy them both.

scenes.caption: They'll kill you if they find out.
scenes.narration: Draven reaches for her, torn between love and the oath sworn in blood. 'If they learn what you are, they will burn you alive.'

scenes.caption: So the little liar remembers now.
scenes.narration: But the chamber doors crash open. The Rival Luna, Seraphine, stands smiling—she has seen everything.

scenes.caption: Choose now, Alpha—her, or your throne.
scenes.narration: 'Guards,' Seraphine purrs, 'the Luna is the prophesied traitor.' Steel scrapes as Draven steps between them—and Kaela's scar erupts in blinding fire.

episodes.title: My Enemy Was My Mate All Along

scenes.caption: The scar remembers what I forgot.
scenes.narration: The scar on my palm burns like a brand as the memories flood back. Every truth I buried claws its way to the surface.

scenes.caption: My enemy... carries my mark.
scenes.narration: Kael stands before me, the Alpha I swore to destroy. But the mark on his neck matches mine—a bond written in blood.

scenes.caption: You were mine all along.
scenes.narration: "You were mine before you hated me," he whispers. The room spins as the lie of my life shatters.

scenes.caption: How can I love what I must kill?
scenes.narration: Rage and longing war inside me. This monster killed my family—yet my soul screams that he is my other half.

scenes.caption: The rival Luna knows the truth.
scenes.narration: Then Seraphine steps from the shadows, her smile cruel. "Did he tell you who really slaughtered your bloodline?"

scenes.caption: He protected me... with a lie.
scenes.narration: "It was me," Seraphine laughs. "And Kael let it happen—to protect you." The dagger falls from my hand.

scenes.caption: Choose me now—or we both die.
scenes.narration: Suddenly Kael clutches his chest, black veins spreading across his skin. "The bond is breaking," he gasps. "If you don't choose me now... we both die."

episodes.title: War at the Gates, Fire in My Veins

scenes.caption: War has come to our gates.
scenes.narration: The war horns scream across the valley, and I stand at the gates of a kingdom that once called me traitor. My blood burns with a magic I cannot name, and the man I swore to destroy is riding toward me.

scenes.caption: My enemy. My mate.
scenes.narration: Kael halts his warhorse before me, golden eyes blazing with a love he refuses to speak. My hand trembles on my blade—kill him, or remember why I ever loved him.

scenes.caption: The mark burns like fire.
scenes.narration: 'You marked me, then you damned me,' I whisper, the bite scar searing on my neck. He reaches for me, and the fire in my veins erupts like a caged god awakening.

scenes.caption: The dead Luna returns for war.
scenes.narration: From the shadows, Morgana rises—the rival Luna who should be dead. Her smile is poison as she raises the enemy banner against us both.

scenes.caption: I was made to destroy him.
scenes.narration: 'Your Luna was never yours, Kael—she was my weapon,' Morgana laughs. And suddenly the memories flood back—I am the blade forged to end his bloodline.

scenes.caption: Fight the lie inside you.
scenes.narration: Kael shields me with his own body as arrows rain down. 'Fight it, Seraphine—remember us, not the lie they built inside you.'

scenes.caption: The Luna awakens at last.
scenes.narration: The fire in my veins answers—not to Morgana, but to him. I raise my hands, and the whole battlefield ignites in silver flame.

scenes.caption: Choose—his life or our child.
scenes.narration: But as the flames clear, Morgana holds a blade to Kael's throat—and forces the words that shatter me: 'Choose, little Luna. His life, or the child growing in your womb.'

episodes.title: The Luna Who Chose the Throne

scenes.caption: The scar remembers what I forgot.
scenes.narration: Fire still smolders at the pack gates, but Selene stands untouched, the crescent scar on her collarbone blazing with silver light. This is the moment she stops running from what she is.

scenes.caption: Come with me. Please.
scenes.narration: Kael reaches for her through the smoke, his amber eyes desperate. The Alpha who once swore to end her bloodline now begs her to run.

scenes.caption: The dead don't stay buried.
scenes.narration: But Morgana rises from the ashes, red hair like living flame, the rival Luna who cheated death. 'The throne was always mine,' she hisses.

scenes.caption: I remember everything now.
scenes.narration: Selene's memories flood back in a violent wave—her mother's crown, her stolen birthright, the blood oath. She was never just a bride. She was born to rule.

scenes.caption: One throne. Two enemies.
scenes.narration: She turns to Kael, the mate she vowed to destroy. 'To end this war, one of us must take the throne.' His face breaks.

scenes.caption: The Luna chooses the throne.
scenes.narration: Selene climbs the ancient dais, silver light erupting from her scar, and seizes the crown. The pack falls silent, kneeling to their true Luna.

scenes.caption: He draws his blade on his mate.
scenes.narration: But as the crown touches her brow, Kael's eyes darken to black and his voice turns cold. 'Then I have no choice but to kill my Luna.' He unsheathes his blade.

episodes.title: The Widow Who Was Never a Wife

scenes.caption: I'm burying a husband who was never mine.
scenes.narration: They lower a mahogany casket into cold earth, and everyone believes I am burying my husband. But Adrian Vale and I were never married—this funeral is the most beautiful lie I have ever told.

scenes.caption: The vultures circle the fake widow.
scenes.narration: The Vale family surrounds me like vultures, whispering that a nobody stole their fortune. Little do they know I signed nothing, promised nothing—I simply played the role too perfectly.

scenes.caption: Sole heir to a billion-dollar empire.
scenes.narration: The lawyer reads the will and names me sole heir to the Vale empire. Gasps fill the room, but my heart is ice—this was always the plan.

scenes.caption: Finally free. Finally rich.
scenes.narration: That night I stand before his portrait and finally breathe. Every debt paid, every enemy blind—I am free, and I am rich.

scenes.caption: The man I buried is at my door.
scenes.narration: But at midnight the doorbell shatters my triumph. A silhouette stands in the storm, alive, impossible—the man I just buried.

scenes.caption: 'Hello, wife.'
scenes.narration: 'Hello, wife,' he says, though we were never wed. His blue eyes burn with a betrayal I never gave him.

scenes.caption: He knows my real secret.
scenes.narration: He walks past me into the home I stole, claiming everything—the money, the name, the revenge. And then he whispers that he knows exactly who I really am.

scenes.caption: He holds the photo that could destroy me.
scenes.narration: He turns, holding a photograph of me from a life I buried long ago. 'You forgot one thing, Elena,' he smiles coldly. 'I never actually died—and neither did your past.'

episodes.title: Reading of a Will That Names a Stranger

scenes.caption: The reading begins.
scenes.narration: The mahogany doors close behind me like a coffin lid. I am here to mourn a man I never married—yet everyone believes I was his wife.

scenes.caption: One final condition.
scenes.narration: The lawyer's eyes find mine, cold and knowing. 'Mrs. Ashford,' he says, 'the estate has one final condition.'

scenes.caption: The heir is a stranger.
scenes.narration: He reads the name of the sole heir. It is not mine. It belongs to a stranger I have never heard.

scenes.caption: But he's supposed to be dead.
scenes.narration: 'Everything he owned,' the lawyer continues, 'passes to a man named Julian Ashford.' The room gasps. Julian Ashford is supposed to be dead.

scenes.caption: The vultures circle.
scenes.narration: Whispers slither through the room. The vultures who once ignored me now stare, hungry for my downfall.

scenes.caption: The doors burst open.
scenes.narration: Then the doors burst open. A tall man in a dark suit steps into the light—and my blood turns to ice.

scenes.caption: 'Hello, wife.'
scenes.narration: His eyes lock on mine, a cruel smile curving his lips. 'Hello, wife,' he says. 'Did you enjoy my funeral?'

scenes.caption: The dead have returned.
scenes.narration: The man I buried is standing before me, alive—and he knows every lie I've told. My revenge just became a war I might not survive.

episodes.title: The Dead Man at My Doorstep

scenes.caption: Midnight. Someone is at the door.
scenes.narration: The reading of the will still echoes in her ears when the doorbell rings at midnight. Clara Vaughn, the widow who was never a wife, freezes with dread.

scenes.caption: A dead man at my doorstep.
scenes.narration: She opens the door—and the world stops. A man lies collapsed on her doorstep, drenched in rain, blood on his shirt.

scenes.caption: It's him. The man I buried.
scenes.narration: She kneels, turns his face to the light—and screams. It is Adrian Kane. The husband she buried. The husband she never married.

scenes.caption: 'Hello, wife. Miss me?'
scenes.narration: His eyes flutter open. His lips form words that shatter everything she has built. 'Hello, wife. Miss me?'

scenes.caption: He knows everything.
scenes.narration: She drags him inside, heart pounding with fury and fear. He faked his death—and now he knows her lie. The fake widow of a living man.

scenes.caption: 'Now you'll pay it back.'
scenes.narration: 'You inherited my fortune pretending to grieve me,' he whispers. 'Now you'll pay it back—with everything you have.'

scenes.caption: Someone else is coming.
scenes.narration: But before she can answer, headlights slash across the windows. A black car rolls through her gates. Someone else knows he's alive.

scenes.caption: To be continued…
scenes.narration: A gunshot cracks the night. The window explodes. And Clara realizes—the man she buried came home with enemies who won't stop until they're both dead.

episodes.title: A Marriage Contract Signed in Blood

scenes.caption: You were supposed to be dead.
scenes.narration: He stands in the doorway of the mansion he supposedly died in, alive and unbroken. The man they buried three months ago now smiles like a wolf.

scenes.caption: We were never married... were we?
scenes.narration: Elena's hands tremble as Adrian slides a document across the polished table. A marriage contract, dated the day of his 'death.'

scenes.caption: Sign, or lose everything you love.
scenes.narration: His voice is ice. Sign it, and everything he stole from her family will be returned. Refuse, and she loses it all.

scenes.caption: This contract is signed in blood.
scenes.narration: The pen he offers is no ordinary pen. A single drop of blood must seal this vow—an old family curse made real.

scenes.caption: I married you for revenge.
scenes.narration: As her blood touches the paper, Adrian leans close and whispers the truth she feared most. He never loved her—he needed her.

scenes.caption: You should have stayed dead.
scenes.narration: But Elena is not the fragile widow he believes. Behind her tears, a plan ignites—she will bury him for real this time.

scenes.caption: He's already married—to me.
scenes.narration: Then the study doors burst open. A woman in red strides in, clutching an identical marriage contract bearing Adrian's signature.

scenes.caption: Which wife will he bury next?
scenes.narration: Adrian's face drains white. Two contracts, two wives, one deadly game—and Elena finally sees the trap closing around them both.

episodes.title: His Enemies Think I'm the Key

scenes.caption: They think I know his secrets.
scenes.narration: They came for me before dawn, black cars circling like vultures. The dead man's enemies believe I hold the key to his empire.

scenes.caption: Adrian: They will burn everything to find it.
scenes.narration: Adrian, my resurrected husband, grips my arm. He warns me they'll never stop hunting until they get what they want.

scenes.caption: The woman in red knows too much.
scenes.narration: A stranger in a crimson coat steps forward, smiling. She claims Adrian hid a fortune inside a code only I can unlock.

scenes.caption: I'm in a photo I don't remember.
scenes.narration: They show me a photograph—my own face beside a bank vault I've never seen. My hands tremble as the past rewrites itself.

scenes.caption: Adrian: Trust no one but me.
scenes.narration: Adrian pulls me aside, whispering that everything they told me is a lie designed to turn me against him.

scenes.caption: My mother's initials. How?
scenes.narration: But the woman in red slides a key across the table—engraved with my dead mother's initials. My blood runs cold.

scenes.caption: They opened fire.
scenes.narration: Suddenly gunfire shatters the windows. Adrian throws me to the floor as glass rains down like knives.

scenes.caption: He came back to bury me.
scenes.narration: In the chaos the woman in red leans down and whispers: 'He didn't come back for you—he came back to bury you.' Then everything goes black.

episodes.title: The Kiss That Was a Trap

scenes.caption: One kiss to sell the lie.
scenes.narration: They call it a charity gala, but I know it's a battlefield. Adrian pulls me close, whispering that one kiss will convince his enemies we're truly wed.

scenes.caption: The kiss that changed everything.
scenes.narration: I hate how my heart betrays me. As his lips meet mine, the whole room turns to watch — and somewhere, a camera flashes like a gunshot.

scenes.caption: It was all a setup.
scenes.narration: But the kiss was never for love. Adrian's grip tightens — he's steering me toward a man in the shadows, the one who wants me dead.

scenes.caption: "Smile, or we both die."
scenes.narration: "Smile," he murmurs, "or we both die tonight." I realize the trap was never for our enemies. It was for me.

scenes.caption: A stranger knows my secret.
scenes.narration: The silver-haired stranger takes my hand and kisses it. "Mrs. Voss," he says, "your husband forgot to mention you signed his death warrant."

scenes.caption: The contract was a confession.
scenes.narration: My blood runs cold. The marriage contract I signed in blood — it wasn't a vow. It was a confession, sealing me to a murder I never committed.

scenes.caption: "Everyone is expendable."
scenes.narration: I turn to Adrian, searching for the man I almost trusted. But his eyes are ice. "I told you," he says softly, "everyone here is expendable."

scenes.caption: One shot. Everything shatters.
scenes.narration: Then the lights die. A single gunshot echoes through the ballroom, and when the chandelier flickers back — Adrian is lying at my feet, blood blooming across his white shirt.

episodes.title: She Was Working for Them All Along

scenes.caption: The traitor was closer than I feared.
scenes.narration: I found the ledger hidden in Adrian's study—proof that someone inside the estate has been leaking our every move. My hands tremble as I recognize the handwriting.

scenes.caption: He came back from the dead for this moment.
scenes.narration: Adrian bursts in, his tall frame filling the doorway, eyes cold as winter steel. He knows what I've discovered.

scenes.caption: The betrayal has a face I trusted.
scenes.narration: 'You were working for them all along,' he says. But the name on the ledger isn't mine—it's his sister's.

scenes.caption: His own blood sold him out.
scenes.narration: Vivienne appears from the shadows, her platinum hair gleaming, a cruel smile curling her lips. She's been feeding secrets to Adrian's enemies for years.

scenes.caption: He shields the woman he never truly married.
scenes.narration: 'You should have stayed dead, brother,' Vivienne hisses, drawing a small silver pistol. Adrian steps in front of me without hesitation.

scenes.caption: Everything was a lie to keep me alive.
scenes.narration: In the chaos, Adrian whispers the truth: our fake marriage was the only thing keeping his enemies from killing me. I was never the target—I was the shield.

scenes.caption: Someone else wanted her silenced.
scenes.narration: A gunshot shatters the silence. Vivienne collapses—shot from behind by a masked figure stepping through the terrace doors.

scenes.caption: Two men. One dead husband. One deadly truth.
scenes.narration: The masked figure lowers the gun and removes the mask—it's my husband's face, identical, impossible. 'The Adrian you married,' he says, 'was never the real one.'

episodes.title: The Night the Empire Turned on Me

scenes.caption: The whole empire turns against me.
scenes.narration: They said I was one of them. Tonight, the entire empire wants me dead.

scenes.caption: He came back for me.
scenes.narration: Adrian returns—my husband from the grave, his eyes colder than the day I buried him.

scenes.caption: You don't know the truth.
scenes.narration: 'You betrayed me,' he whispers. But he doesn't know I was betraying them for him.

scenes.caption: They forged my crimes.
scenes.narration: The board members circle like wolves, papers in hand—proof they forged to destroy us both.

scenes.caption: Here's the real truth.
scenes.narration: I slam the real evidence on the table. 'I never worked for them—I've been protecting you all along.'

scenes.caption: He finally believes me.
scenes.narration: Adrian's face breaks. For the first time, the dead man looks like he might weep.

scenes.caption: Lights out. A gunshot.
scenes.narration: Then the lights die. A gunshot cracks. And someone screams my name in the dark.

scenes.caption: The gun is in my hand.
scenes.narration: When the lights return, Adrian is on the floor—bleeding—and the gun is in my hand.

episodes.title: One Signature Left to Destroy Him

scenes.caption: One signature left to destroy him.
scenes.narration: They think one signature will finish him. But I hold the pen now, and I hold his fate.

scenes.caption: He came back for me.
scenes.narration: Adrian appears from the shadows, the dead man who refused to stay buried, his eyes begging me not to sign.

scenes.caption: They promised me freedom.
scenes.narration: 'Sign it,' his enemies hiss through the phone. 'And you walk away rich.' But rich was never what I wanted.

scenes.caption: Will you kill me twice?
scenes.narration: He steps closer, voice breaking. 'You buried me once. Will you kill me twice?'

scenes.caption: Everything was a lie—except us.
scenes.narration: I remember the marriage contract signed in blood, the lies, the kiss that was a trap. But I also remember the truth in his eyes.

scenes.caption: I choose him.
scenes.narration: So I press the pen down—and tear the document in half instead. 'I choose him.'

scenes.caption: They know I betrayed them.
scenes.narration: The doors burst open. His enemies flood in, guns drawn, faces twisted with betrayal.

scenes.caption: One gunshot. One secret left.
scenes.narration: Adrian shields me, whispering, 'There's one secret left—the one that will destroy them all.' Then a single gunshot echoes.

episodes.title: The Widow Takes the Throne

scenes.caption: They thought I came to mourn. I came to rule.
scenes.narration: They summoned me to the boardroom expecting a grieving fool. Instead, I walk in wearing his empire like a crown.

scenes.caption: One document. One name they never expected.
scenes.narration: The board laughs, certain a signature can't save me. They don't know the man watching from the shadows.

scenes.caption: The dead man rises to claim his throne.
scenes.narration: Then he steps into the light—Adrian, the husband I buried, alive and armed with the truth.

scenes.caption: Every lie they buried is unearthed.
scenes.narration: He reads their crimes aloud, every betrayal I once took the blame for. The room drains of color.

scenes.caption: He crowns me before his enemies.
scenes.narration: He takes my hand before them all and names me chairwoman. The widow becomes the queen.

scenes.caption: A warning hidden in my own hand.
scenes.narration: But victory tastes of poison. In my palm, a note only I can read—someone in this room already knows my final secret.

scenes.caption: The one crime I never confessed.
scenes.narration: I lift my eyes—and Adrian's phone lights up with a photo of me the night his brother died.

scenes.caption: The queen's darkest secret just surfaced.
scenes.narration: His grip on my hand turns to iron. 'Elena,' he whispers, 'what did you do?'—and the throne beneath us begins to crack.

episodes.title: The Man Everyone Stepped Over

scenes.caption: Just the janitor. Nobody special.
scenes.narration: Every morning he arrives before dawn, invisible to the world that walks past him.

scenes.caption: 'Clean it up, old man.'
scenes.narration: They laugh. They toss their trash at his feet and call him a servant of nothing.

scenes.caption: He carries a secret older than empires.
scenes.narration: But Amir never bows in shame. He kneels like a man remembering a throne.

scenes.caption: A ring from a kingdom that fell.
scenes.narration: In his locker hangs no photograph—only a tarnished ring bearing the crest of a fallen crown.

scenes.caption: They came looking for someone.
scenes.narration: Then the doors burst open. A convoy of black cars floods the street outside.

scenes.caption: 'Where is he? Where is our king?'
scenes.narration: A woman in royal robes strides through the lobby, her eyes searching every face.

scenes.caption: They knelt... to the man they mocked.
scenes.narration: The mockers freeze as the guards drop to one knee—facing the janitor with the mop.

scenes.caption: 'Your Majesty... it is time to come home.'
scenes.narration: The royal woman bows her head and whispers the words that will shatter his hidden life forever.

episodes.title: A Slap in Front of the Whole Office

scenes.caption: Just another morning for the janitor.
scenes.narration: In the gleaming lobby of Halcyon Tower, Marcus pushes his mop, invisible to the world that steps over him.

scenes.caption: 'You missed a spot, old man.'
scenes.narration: Vanessa, the ruthless office manager, sees him and sneers. To her, he is nothing but a stain to be scrubbed away.

scenes.caption: The bucket spills. Everyone laughs.
scenes.narration: She kicks over his bucket, water flooding across the floor as the whole office turns to watch.

scenes.caption: He does not flinch.
scenes.narration: Marcus kneels calmly, wiping the water. His silence only enrages her more.

scenes.caption: The slap heard by everyone.
scenes.narration: Then her hand flies. A slap cracks across his face, echoing through the frozen office.

scenes.caption: A king does not stay kneeling.
scenes.narration: Marcus slowly rises, touching his cheek. For the first time, something ancient and powerful flickers in his eyes.

scenes.caption: 'Your Majesty, we have found you.'
scenes.narration: Suddenly the glass doors burst open. A dozen men in black suits stride in, bowing low before the janitor.

scenes.caption: The janitor was a king all along.
scenes.narration: Vanessa's face drains white as the truth crashes down. The man she slapped was never just a janitor.

episodes.title: The Stranger Who Bowed to the Janitor

scenes.caption: Just another day for the man they ignore.
scenes.narration: The morning shift begins like any other, Marcus pushing his mop across the marble lobby, invisible as always.

scenes.caption: Who is this stranger?
scenes.narration: Then the glass doors part—and a tall stranger in a black tailored suit strides in like he owns the world.

scenes.caption: They all think he's here for the boss.
scenes.narration: The office workers freeze. This man radiates power—and everyone assumes he's here for the executives upstairs.

scenes.caption: He walks past everyone... to the janitor.
scenes.narration: But the stranger walks past the CEO, past the receptionist, straight toward the man with the mop.

scenes.caption: He kneels before the janitor.
scenes.narration: And then, before the entire stunned office, the stranger drops to one knee and bows his head low.

scenes.caption: 'Your Majesty... I found you.'
scenes.narration: "Your Majesty," the stranger whispers, "I have finally found you." The mop slips from Marcus's trembling hands.

scenes.caption: The woman who slapped him goes pale.
scenes.narration: The whole office gasps. The woman who slapped him yesterday clutches her chest in horror.

scenes.caption: 'The kingdom needs you back... tonight.'
scenes.narration: The stranger rises, eyes burning. "The kingdom is falling. And only you can return to take the throne—tonight."

episodes.title: Dinner With the People Who Fired Me

scenes.caption: They fired me. Now they want dinner.
scenes.narration: The invitation arrives on gold-trimmed paper. The very company that fired me now begs me to dinner. They have no idea who they truly summoned.

scenes.caption: Still just the janitor to them.
scenes.narration: They seat me at the far end, snickering behind champagne glasses. To them I am still the man who mopped their floors.

scenes.caption: A toast to knowing your place.
scenes.narration: Miranda, the CEO who slapped me, raises her glass in mockery. 'A toast,' she sneers, 'to knowing your place.'

scenes.caption: My place is a throne.
scenes.narration: I set down my fork. 'My place,' I say softly, 'is a throne you cannot imagine.' The laughter dies.

scenes.caption: The doors burst open.
scenes.narration: The grand doors burst open. Armored royal guards flood the room, banners of a golden lion unfurling behind them.

scenes.caption: Your Majesty. Your kingdom awaits.
scenes.narration: The guards drop to one knee before me. 'Your Majesty,' their captain declares, 'your kingdom awaits your return.'

scenes.caption: The glass shatters. So does her world.
scenes.narration: Miranda's glass shatters on the floor. Her face drains of color as she finally understands the man she struck.

scenes.caption: The traitor is at this table.
scenes.narration: The captain steps closer. 'Sire, there is one more matter.' He lowers his voice. 'The traitor who exiled you... is at this very table.'

episodes.title: The Ring That Proves a Bloodline

scenes.caption: They handed him the royal ring.
scenes.narration: Marcus stands in the marble lobby, still wearing his gray janitor uniform, when the old envoy places a velvet box in his trembling hands. Inside gleams a ring older than the empire itself.

scenes.caption: The whole office went silent.
scenes.narration: The office workers who once laughed freeze in place, phones lowered. The janitor they slapped is holding a crown's promise in his palm.

scenes.caption: Only true blood can awaken it.
scenes.narration: The envoy kneels, voice breaking. 'This ring answers only to the blood of King Adaeze. Press it to the seal, my lord.'

scenes.caption: The impostor's touch rejected it.
scenes.narration: Sneering, his old boss Vincent snatches for the ring. 'A janitor, royalty? This is a scam!' But the moment his fingers touch the gold, it burns cold and dark.

scenes.caption: The ring blazed at his blood.
scenes.narration: Marcus lifts the ring to the ancient seal. It flares to life, golden light spilling across the lobby, illuminating a crest carved into its face—his face.

scenes.caption: They all knelt before the janitor.
scenes.narration: The envoy weeps and bows lower. 'The prophecy is true. You are the lost heir, Your Majesty.' Around him, every stranger in dark coats drops to one knee.

scenes.caption: The enemy just made a call.
scenes.narration: But Vincent backs toward the door, phone pressed to his ear, whispering. 'He's alive. The heir is alive. Send them now.'

scenes.caption: They came to end the bloodline.
scenes.narration: As Marcus turns toward the crowd, the lobby doors burst open—armed men in black storm inside. The envoy shields him, screaming, 'They've come to kill the king!'

episodes.title: She Chose Their Side—and I Let Her

scenes.caption: The one person I trusted.
scenes.narration: For years I mopped these floors while they laughed. But the one betrayal I never saw coming came from her—Elena, the only one who ever smiled at me.

scenes.caption: She looked away.
scenes.narration: They gathered like wolves—the executives who fired me, now trembling before my bloodline. But Elena would not meet my eyes.

scenes.caption: She rose. She chose them.
scenes.narration: The royal envoy demanded loyalty from everyone in that room. When they pointed to Elena, she rose—and walked to their side.

scenes.caption: 'A janitor playing king.'
scenes.narration: 'He is nothing,' she whispered to them. 'A janitor playing king.' Each word a blade through the last piece of my heart.

scenes.caption: I let her walk away.
scenes.narration: I could have shown them the ring. I could have crushed her with a single word. Instead, I let her go.

scenes.caption: 'Speak the word, Majesty.'
scenes.narration: The envoy stepped forward, stunned. 'Your Majesty, she has betrayed the crown. Speak the word, and she is finished.'

scenes.caption: What is she hiding?
scenes.narration: I looked at Elena one last time. And in her trembling hands, I saw something clenched—a photograph she never meant for me to find.

scenes.caption: The dead just walked in.
scenes.narration: Then the doors burst open—and the person in that photograph walked in alive. Suddenly, her betrayal made a terrible kind of sense.

episodes.title: The Betrayal Hidden in the Old Photograph

scenes.caption: One photo. A lifetime of lies.
scenes.narration: The dusty photograph slips from the envelope, and thirty years of silence come crashing down. In the faded image, a young Elias stands smiling beside the man who would one day steal his crown.

scenes.caption: The man who bowed... was there all along.
scenes.narration: He recognizes the face instantly—Lord Aldric, the loyal envoy who bowed before him. But in this photo, Aldric's hand rests on the shoulder of the general who led the coup.

scenes.caption: He came the moment he knew.
scenes.narration: Behind him, the door creaks. Lord Aldric stands in the doorway, silver hair immaculate, white gloves folded, his eyes falling to the photograph in Elias's trembling grip.

scenes.caption: 'You knelt... knowing the truth.'
scenes.narration: 'You knew who took everything from me,' Elias whispers, 'and you knelt at my feet anyway.' Aldric's composure fractures for the first time.

scenes.caption: 'The real traitor is closer than you think.'
scenes.narration: 'I protected you,' Aldric confesses, voice breaking. 'The photograph is not what it seems. The traitor was never me—it was someone you still trust.'

scenes.caption: She stops the instant she sees it.
scenes.narration: A pair of heels clicks down the hallway. Vivian appears, auburn hair perfect, her smile faltering as she sees the photograph in his hand.

scenes.caption: She was there. She was always there.
scenes.narration: Elias turns the photo toward her—and in the corner, half-hidden, stands a young girl with auburn hair. Vivian's own face, at her father's side, the day the kingdom fell.

scenes.caption: Then everything went black.
scenes.narration: 'Tell me it isn't you,' Elias begs. Vivian opens her mouth—but the lights slam to darkness, and a gunshot echoes through the hall.

episodes.title: Return of the Exiled Prince

scenes.caption: The janitor they mocked has returned.
scenes.narration: For years, Elias mopped these floors in silence. Today, black motorcades line the street, and the man they mocked stands taller than they ever imagined.

scenes.caption: Kneel for the exiled prince.
scenes.narration: General Marek kneels before him, sword in hand. 'Your Highness, the exile is over. Your throne awaits.'

scenes.caption: The ones who fired him now tremble.
scenes.narration: The same executives who fired him now tremble. Mr. Dalton, who once slapped him, cannot meet his eyes.

scenes.caption: She chose wrong.
scenes.narration: Then she appears—Vivian, the woman who chose their side. Her face crumbles as the truth engulfs her.

scenes.caption: The ring never lied.
scenes.narration: 'You let me walk away,' she whispers. Elias only removes his gloves, revealing the royal signet ring that changes everything.

scenes.caption: The enemy is already here.
scenes.narration: General Marek's voice hardens. 'Your Highness, there is a danger. The usurper who exiled you—he is already inside this building.'

scenes.caption: A ghost from the past.
scenes.narration: Elias scans the crowd of terrified faces—and freezes. Behind the CEO's desk sits a man he thought long dead.

scenes.caption: Only one can wear the crown.
scenes.narration: The usurper rises with a smile. 'Welcome home, cousin. But a crown only fits one head.' A gunshot echoes through the lobby.

episodes.title: The Kingdom Wants Its Throne Back

scenes.caption: The kingdom has arrived.
scenes.narration: The convoy of black cars pours through the office gates, banners of the exiled kingdom snapping in the wind. They have come for Marcus—the janitor who was born a king.

scenes.caption: They kneel to the man they mocked.
scenes.narration: Marcus Vane stands in his faded gray janitor uniform, mop still in hand, as the royal guard kneels before him on the marble floor. The whole office watches, frozen.

scenes.caption: The throne stands empty.
scenes.narration: General Aldric, scarred and grim, rises to speak. 'Your Highness, the usurper is dying. The throne is empty. The people are calling your name.'

scenes.caption: Forgiven before she asked.
scenes.narration: Elena pushes through the crowd, tears streaming. 'You knew all along and you let me betray you?' Marcus does not turn. 'I forgave you before you asked.'

scenes.caption: A crown on a janitor's cart.
scenes.narration: The general lays the crown upon the janitor's cart—gold gleaming beside a bucket of dirty water. 'Take what was stolen from you, my king.'

scenes.caption: The usurper's last card.
scenes.narration: But as Marcus reaches for the crown, his phone buzzes. A single photo—his young daughter, bound, a knife at her throat. The usurper's final move.

scenes.caption: A king rides to war.
scenes.narration: Marcus lifts the crown at last—but his eyes burn with a father's fury. 'The kingdom can wait. My daughter cannot.' He turns to the door, and war begins.

scenes.caption: One shot changes everything.
scenes.narration: As he steps outside, a sniper's red dot settles on his chest. Elena screams his name. The screen cuts to black on a single gunshot.

episodes.title: Kneel, or Lose Everything You Stole

scenes.caption: They summoned a servant. A sovereign arrived.
scenes.narration: They dragged Elias into the boardroom expecting a broken janitor. Instead, a king walked in—crown of exile still fresh on his brow.

scenes.caption: The doors locked. So did his fate.
scenes.narration: Mr. Crane, the CEO who once slapped him, laughed—until the royal guards sealed every exit.

scenes.caption: Everything you own was never yours.
scenes.narration: He set the deeds on the table—every asset they stole was built on stolen crown land.

scenes.caption: She picked their side. Now she trembles.
scenes.narration: Mara stood among them, torn between the people she'd chosen and the man she'd abandoned.

scenes.caption: Kneel—or lose it all.
scenes.narration: "Kneel," he commanded, "or lose everything you stole." The word echoed like a blade.

scenes.caption: They all knelt. Except one.
scenes.narration: One by one, the executives sank to their knees—all but Crane, whose hand crept toward a hidden phone.

scenes.caption: It was a trap from the start.
scenes.narration: Crane pressed the button—and beyond the glass, armed men flooded the corridor. Mara screamed the truth: this was a trap all along.

episodes.title: The Princess Who Poured His Coffee

scenes.caption: The crown she left behind
scenes.narration: Princess Elara flees the palace with nothing but a stolen apron and a secret that could topple a kingdom. Tonight, she is no royal — only a waitress at a roadside diner.

scenes.caption: Just one more shift
scenes.narration: She swore she'd vanish forever. But fate has a cruel sense of humor.

scenes.caption: The enemy at the door
scenes.narration: Then the door opens — and in walks Damian Kane, the ruthless duke who hunts her crown.

scenes.caption: He has no idea who she is
scenes.narration: He doesn't recognize her. To him she's nothing — a girl with a coffee pot and trembling hands.

scenes.caption: A bounty on a princess
scenes.narration: On the table lies a folder — her royal portrait, circled in red ink. He's here to end her.

scenes.caption: Don't look at me
scenes.narration: Her hand shakes. A single drop of coffee splashes onto his sleeve — and his cold eyes rise to meet hers.

scenes.caption: 'Have we met before?'
scenes.narration: 'You look familiar,' he murmurs, catching her wrist. The whole kingdom hangs on this heartbeat.

scenes.caption: Your Highness.
scenes.narration: She wrenches free, and her cap tumbles — spilling a cascade of auburn hair he has seen before... on a wanted poster. Recognition ignites in his eyes.

episodes.title: A Tiara in the Trash Bin

scenes.caption: A crown buried in garbage.
scenes.narration: In the cramped diner backroom, Princess Elara clutches a diamond tiara wrapped in a greasy dish towel. She hides it deep inside the trash bin, praying no one will ever find her true self.

scenes.caption: The enemy has arrived.
scenes.narration: But through the swinging door, Viktor Kane watches with cold, calculating eyes. The ruthless duke who hunts her crown has followed the trail to this very diner.

scenes.caption: Don't let him see the princess.
scenes.narration: Elara spins around, heart pounding, and forces a trembling waitress smile. 'Table five, sir?' she stammers, hoping he won't recognize the girl beneath the apron.

scenes.caption: He almost remembers her.
scenes.narration: Viktor's gaze lingers on her face, a flicker of recognition burning in his eyes. 'You have the look of someone I once hunted,' he murmurs, stirring his coffee slowly.

scenes.caption: The tiara is walking out the door!
scenes.narration: A busboy grabs the trash bag, unaware of the treasure inside. Elara lunges, spilling coffee across Viktor's lap in sheer panic.

scenes.caption: The secret spills onto the floor.
scenes.narration: Viktor seizes her wrist, and the greasy towel slips from her sleeve. The tiara tumbles onto the checkered floor, glittering like a betrayal.

scenes.caption: Found. At last.
scenes.narration: Their eyes meet over the fallen crown. 'Your Highness,' Viktor breathes, a triumphant smile spreading. 'I've been searching everywhere for you.'

scenes.caption: Someone wants her dead.
scenes.narration: But as Viktor reaches for the crown, a gunshot shatters the diner window. Elara screams — someone else wants the princess too, and they want her dead.

episodes.title: He Offered Her a Job—and a Trap

scenes.caption: He came back for her.
scenes.narration: He returns to her diner at dawn, his dark eyes searching for her face beneath the harsh fluorescent lights.

scenes.caption: A job offer with hidden claws.
scenes.narration: "I'm looking for an assistant," he says smoothly. "Someone discreet. Someone like you." She feels the trap closing.

scenes.caption: The enemy holds out a golden lie.
scenes.narration: She knows this man wants her crown—but the pay could buy her freedom. Every instinct screams run.

scenes.caption: Her stolen crown remembers everything.
scenes.narration: In the kitchen she clutches the discarded tiara, its jewels dulled by dust. Her past will not stay buried.

scenes.caption: She takes the bait—on purpose.
scenes.narration: "I accept," she whispers, chin high like the royalty she buried. If he wants a game, she will play it too.

scenes.caption: Into the heart of the enemy.
scenes.narration: He drives her to a towering glass headquarters, its shadow swallowing the city. She steps into the lion's den.

scenes.caption: He hunts a princess he already found.
scenes.narration: On his office wall hangs a royal portrait—her family's crest. "I've been hunting your princess for years," he says, not knowing she is the prey.

scenes.caption: One photo away from the truth.
scenes.narration: Then his phone lights up with a photo—the runaway princess's face. Her face. His thumb hovers over it, and slowly, he turns to look at her.
